Thalès

A French-language school that teaches the diaspora in the United States, Canada and Europe to trade listed options with a method. Animated lessons, a seeded market simulator, a strategy laboratory, a guide to AI trading agents and an online book sit behind a $10 monthly subscription, with access derived from Stripe at request time.

Engineering recordFor technical reviewers

Designed and shipped end to end: product, pricing model, access control, the pricing maths and the Stripe and Supabase integration. The interesting problem was gating paid content without keeping a subscriber table that could drift from Stripe.

A member opens the simulator. The middleware reads the Supabase session from cookies, then the access cookie; if it is missing or expired, the server asks Stripe for the customer’s subscriptions and completed checkout sessions by email, merges any grant stored in app_metadata, signs the answer with HMAC and sets it for 20 minutes. The page renders on the server, and from there pricing runs entirely in the browser.

Key engineering decisions

01

Stripe as the only source of payment truth

No webhook, no subscriber table: access is derived on demand and cached briefly. Nothing can drift, at the cost of a Stripe call every 20 minutes per active member and a delay before a cancellation is seen.

02

Asymmetric cache lifetime

A positive answer is cached for 20 minutes and a negative one for 2, so someone who has just paid is let in almost at once while members do not hit Stripe on every click.

03

Pricing on the client

Black-Scholes and the payoff integration run in the browser, so the simulator and the lab respond instantly and cost nothing to serve; a seeded generator makes every game reproducible.

Notes for reviewers

Data modelSupabase holds identities only. Payments live in Stripe, admin grants in app_metadata, and the book is a JSON file rendered on the server.
SecurityThe access cookie is signed, bound to the email and compared in constant time. Admin pages check the user server side and POST actions check the request origin; the service-role key never reaches the browser.
TestingScripted browser runs at phone and desktop widths as visitor, member and administrator; a development flag simulates a member locally without touching Stripe.
Limits and next stepsAdd a Stripe webhook to revoke access at once on cancellation, move the rate limit to a shared store, and send reset mail from a custom sender.
01

Problem statement

Options are among the most used instruments on American markets, yet material in plain French for people who earn and save abroad is scarce, and most of it either sells a promise or dwells on loss. Learners need to see how a contract is priced, what a strategy can lose before it is entered, and how a week unfolds, then practise without money at risk.

02

Contribution

A paid school organised as a month of practice: visual basics on who pays whom, twelve lessons worked on real US companies, a simulator that replays eight weeks of market with a live option chain, a laboratory that draws the payoff of a strategy against Friday’s price, ten lessons on connecting an AI agent to a dedicated brokerage account, and a book read online. An administration console lets the owner see accounts, grant access and reset passwords.

03

Architecture

Astro 5 renders every gated page on the server through the Vercel adapter. A single middleware classifies each path as public, login, member, book or admin, and redirects pages or answers the API with 401 or 403. Supabase Auth handles email and password sign-in through cookie sessions. Stripe is the system of record for payments, so there is no table of subscribers: the server looks up the customer’s subscriptions and completed checkout sessions by email with a restricted read-only key, then caches the result in an HMAC-signed, HttpOnly cookie bound to the email, for 20 minutes when access exists and 2 minutes when it does not, so a new payment is picked up quickly. Grants made by the administrator live in Supabase app_metadata, which users cannot edit, and are merged with the Stripe result. Moneta is a server route that calls the Anthropic Messages API with a French system prompt, for members only.

04

Method and data

Option premiums are computed in the browser with Black-Scholes, including delta, gamma, theta and vega, using a polynomial approximation of the normal distribution. The simulator generates each scenario as geometric Brownian motion in daily steps from a seeded generator, with an earnings jump on a set day, so a game can be replayed exactly. The laboratory computes breakeven and maximum loss from the payoff, and the probability of profit by integrating the lognormal distribution of Friday’s price over 600 intervals. Lessons use real US company names with round illustrative prices.

05

Verification and limitations

Each page was checked by scripted browser runs at phone and desktop widths, as a visitor, a member and the administrator, and the payment links were exercised against the live Stripe account. Limits: access is matched by email, so a purchase made under another address must be granted by hand; there is no webhook, so a cancellation is seen when the cached cookie expires; Moneta is limited to eight questions a minute per address, held in the memory of each function instance; password-reset mail uses the provider’s default sender until a custom one is configured; the book is published chapter by chapter. Thalès teaches and does not give investment advice.
